_doc: One server, one endpoint. (1) PLUGIN-scoped MCP: this file sits at the plugin root (marketplace source '.'), so Claude Code auto-discovers it and AUTO-CONNECTS the CometChat server for anyone who installs the plugin. Its docs tools work with no sign-in, and its cometchat_* account tools ask the user to sign in to CometChat the first time one is called (RULES.md 'Canonical doc channel', tier 1). (2) PROJECT-scoped for people WORKING ON this pack: opening this repo connects it too. Excluded from the npm tarball (package.json `files`) because an npm/node_modules install does NOT auto-connect it; the CLI install path wires the MCP itself, and every family's references/docs-map.md still carries a DOCS_BASE fetch fallback (tier 3), so a shipped skill never HARD-STOPS on a missing MCP.

cometchat._note: Hosted CometChat MCP. Docs tools (search_cometchat_docs, fetch_cometchat_doc_page, get_cometchat_implementation_bundle, list_cometchat_bundles) need no sign-in, so docs always work. The cometchat_* account tools that replace @cometchat/skills-cli (apps, credentials, features, API keys, webhooks, users, groups, moderation, push, roles, team, usage) are on the same endpoint: the first call asks the user to sign in to CometChat in the browser (OAuth). Optional: without signing in, skills ask for credentials. Health: https://mcp.cometchat.com/health.
